entities.summary: Stephan Moccio (b. 1972-10-20, St. Catharines) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in St. Catharines and Canada. Known in the fields of canada, composers & musicians, americas.
